answer: Farming becomes a spiral bet on surviving 56 epochs of grading, and every trellis settlement recomputes the opal schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 56 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
